none: PAS SF-3DCCA7: Roman skillet handle terminal fragment
contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of cast copper alloy handle terminal of Romano-British patera or skillet, the sides and one end are broken, the incomplete end is broken across the centre of the circular terminal and suspension hole.
